title: Public Notice – FIM Act Formal Consultation on Subordinate Legislation – October 2023
text:
23 OCTOBER 2023
FORMAL CONSULTATION ON SUBORDINATE LEGISLATION OF THE
FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS AND MARKETS ACT (FIMA)
The Namibia Financial Institutions Supervisory Authority (NAMFISA) herewith informs the public
impacted by the implementation of the Financial Institutions and Markets Act, No. 2 of 2021, of
the following.
1. NAMFISA has uploaded the recently gazetted Subordinate Legislation (Government
Gazette #8237 – GENERAL NOTICE NO. 659 dated 18 October 2023), on the NAMFISA
website, accessible via the link below:
➢ Link: https://www.namfisa.com.na/legislative-instruments/
2. The public is encouraged to review and provide comments on the subordinate legislation.
3. Kindly submit your comments in the format of the enclosed “Comments Template”, on
or before 24 November 2023 to Ms. Anesia Cloete at acloete@namfisa.com.na and
a copy to projectnewdawn@namfisa.com.na.
4. Should you have any queries pertaining to this Public Notice, kindly contact Mr. Calvin
Thembikozi at cthembikozi@namfisa.com.na or via Tel: 061-292 5267 or Mr. Elvin
Kamana at ekamana@namfisa.com.na or via Tel: 061 290 5220.
Yours sincerely,
Kenneth S. Matomola
CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER
